'''Matt''' (Japanese: '''マイク''' ''Mike'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG188|Pinch Healing]]''. He is a Pokésitter and the final character of the day to appear in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''.

Matt was transporting Pokémon by bus when an {{p|Electrode}} fell on it and caused him to have an accident. He called the local [[Pokémon Center]] where the [[Nurse Joy]] in charge happened to be sick. {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}} and [[Scott]] came by to tow the bus. They were about to leave when, all of a sudden, a {{p|Bagon}} that Matt was looking after got lost after chasing a {{p|Butterfree}}.

With the help of Ash, he was able to get Bagon back. However, after the ordeal, Bagon fainted in Matt's arms and that was when he discovered it had a terrible fever. They rushed it to the Pokémon Center as quick as possible. There, Matt couldn't help but feel guilty about Bagon. He felt he had a responsibility to care of the Pokémon Trainers had left with him. During this time, two people came into the Pokémon Center, claiming to be workers from the [[Pokémon Day Care]] center that Matt worked at. They gathered up all of the Pokémon and put them in a box. Matt did not believe their claims, however, and confronted them about it, but then, a smokescreen was spewed from the box. The impostors took off and revealed themselves as {{TRT}}.

As they were escaping in their balloon, Ash almost commanded {{AP|Pikachu}} to use {{m|Thunderbolt}} but stopped when he realized that it would also hurt the Pokémon Team Rocket stole. {{an|May}} remembered that the {{p|Larvitar}} they stole has a powerful {{m|Sandstorm}} attack and asked it to use it. It did so and Team Rocket's balloon crashed as a result. Ash took care of it from there and Team Rocket is defeated. They were approached by {{an|Brock}}, who informed Matt that Bagon's fever had broken, relieving him. The next day, [[Scott]] managed to repair Matt's bus and he was able to return the Pokémon back to their Trainers.

==Trivia==
* Matt shares some similarities with [[Normajean]].
** Both have jobs taking care of other people's Pokémon and the Pokémon they were in charge of got injured and then [[Illness in the Pokémon world|sick]], with {{an|Brock}} helping the Pokémon recover.
** They are also the final [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] of their respective series, ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' and ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''.
